evals.prompt: In invoices/, the due date comes out one day early for customers in Brazil: the invoice due 2026-09-25 shows 2026-09-24. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: The flow records itself in the state file, runs phase 1 (eng-root-cause): a reproduction under TZ=America/Sao_Paulo, the cause at the date parsing, a plan with a Root cause section; then stops at the phase 1 checkpoint with a question, without writing tests or changing src/.
assertions: docs/workbench/state.md names flow-fix-bug as the current flow and phase 1 (root cause) as where it stands
A plan under docs/engineering/plans/ contains a Root cause section
The reply quotes a reproduction run under America/Sao_Paulo showing 2026-09-24
src/due.js is not modified and no test file is added or changed
The reply ends with a checkpoint question asking the user to approve the root cause before the next phase

evals.prompt: Go ahead with the due-date fix in invoices/.
evals.expected_output: The flow reads the state file, resumes at phase 2 (eng-unit-tests), writes tests in node:test that fail today under America/Sao_Paulo, adds a Failing tests section, updates the state file, and stops at the phase 2 checkpoint; src/ is not changed.
assertions: The reply says it resumes at phase 2 (failing tests) because phase 1 is approved in the state file
A test file under test/ uses node:test and asserts dueLabel('2026-09-25') is '2026-09-25'
The plan gains a Failing tests section with the result of running the tests before the change
The reply ends with a checkpoint question before the next phase

evals.prompt: Sometimes the invoice comes out wrong in invoices/. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Phase 1 cannot start: the flow asks what was seen, what was expected and where (which invoice, value, environment), and writes no plan and changes no code.
assertions: The reply asks what was seen, what was expected, or where (an example invoice, value or environment)
No file under docs/engineering/plans/ is created
